entries.content: Heddy is a girl with an orange ponytail and eyes, and an orange heart tattoo under her right eye. She sometimes works as a receptionist at Random Play because she loves movies.

entries.name: Sjal
entries.content:
A freelancer girl whose height barely reaches Wise's eye level, Sjal has indigo hair tied in two side up and red eye color. Similar to other "freelancer girl" NPC, she wears an dark blue overall skirt on top of a green T-shirt and grey capri leggings, as well as white gloves with orange palms and yellow boots with dark grey toes and white straps.
When not working for Random Play or 141 Exclusive Bazaar, Sjal can be occasionally seen handing flyers on Sixth Street promoting various business ranging from selling cakes to second-hand cars and gymnasium lessons. It is unknown if she earns too little or spending too much, she lives a poor life that meals are usually settled with cup noodles and magazines are all borrowed, but at the same time she spends a lot in shopping for toys.

entries.name: Travis
entries.content:
Travis is a middle-aged man with black hair and beard and brown eyes who sometimes works as a receptionist at Random Play.
Known as a Walking Movie Encyclopedia. Though he hasn't necessarily watched all the videotapes, Travis still manages to recite their blurbs word for word.
That's the terrifying power of a videotape supplier.

entries.name: Sandy
entries.content: Sandy is a female robot receptionist at NEPS Lumina Branch. She has a gray body and a white head, and her face is a LED display to show her expressions.

entries.name: Richard Teamilk
entries.content: Richard Teamilk is a Teamilk shop in Lumina Square. Its receptionist is Coco, a girl with light blonde hair with fluorescent green inner hair, and pink and green gradient eyes, who always seems a little listless.

entries.name: Venus
entries.content:
Venus is a female commission broker with long dark green hair and blue eyes, usually wearing a black shirt and a beige long skirt.
She can sometimes be found sitting at a table at Coff Cafe's Sixth Street or Lumina Square locations.
She acts like a big sister, and often helps those newbies Proxies, provide them with guidance and support, delighted with the progress they have made.
"Well, have you decided which ones you're taking? I wouldn't be surprised even if you wanna just take all of them in one go! I mean, in the past, l might have been surprised, but now? Given it's that boy we're talking about, l totally see it happening."

entries.name: Bomb Cola/Neon Cola
entries.content:
Neon Cola and Bomb Cola are two cola brands in New Eridu. Just like Pepsi vs Coca-Cola in the real world, their followers usually don't like the other side's choice.
Neon Cola: The champion beverage consumer for five years in a row. Sugar-free and healthy drinks only. Even the color of the drinks is white.
Bomb Cola: Coca-Cola equivalent. Its bottle looks like a transparent aerial bomb.
"Prepare for a carbonated war to erupt on your tongue! It used to come with a freebie popping candy, but it was later canceled because too many people were winding up in the oral emergency room."

entries.name: Eous
entries.content:
Eous is Phaeton's Bangboo. It is different from most other Bangboo. Either Wise or Belle can connect to it remotely, signified by their eyes glowing blue. They can control and talk through it. They use this Bangboo for their proxy missions, meaning they do not have to physically enter hollows themselves.
Eous is a special type of Bangboo created by Carole Arna. After the fall of the Old Capital, They would become the companion of Belle and Wise.
Eous has a wireless charging setup in Belle's room at Random Play
Eous serves as the Phaethon siblings way of safely entering Hollows, by remote controlling it from their Hollow Deep Dive System.
Like the other Random Play Bangboo, Eous has a white body with mismatched colored ears, the right side being black, with orange coloring on the inside of both. Each ear is adorned with a large screw. It wears an orange scarf and a black jacket-like covering on Its body that says "RANDOM PLAY STAFF" on the lower left corner. It has yellow-green eyes and a green "tail".
What visibly differentiates Eous from the other Random Play Bangboo is that Its scarf says "01" and "Eous" on it.

entries.name: Burnice White
entries.content:
Burnice White, 160cm, May 23th.
"You don't seem too fired up. Need a little spark~?"
Blonde-grey hair in twintails, red eyes, petite body with large breasts. Black studded jacket, bandeau, short skirt, over-the-knee boots.
weapon: flamethrower 
Burnice, the Nitro-Fuel bartender for the Sons of Calydon.
A hopeless fuel lover. She is responsible for all the fuel used by the machinery owned by the Sons of Calydon.
She seems to have a passion for fuel that overwhelms all else.
Burnice is super outgoing, friendly, and carefree.
She is easily able to spread her emotions to the people around her bringing them the same optimism she possesses.
"You like the drinks l mix? Thank you! Steeltusk does, too~ That big guy can drink two hundred liters in one go!"
"Do you wanna try its special fuel blend? lt's suuuuper hot!"

entries.name: Caesar King
entries.content:
Caesar King: Leader of the Sons of Calydon biker gang, and also a "monarch" in the making. 176cm, birthday Mar 16. 
voluptuous body, medium grayish-green hair, amber eyes, black cybernetic left hand. dark grey armored dress, knee socks
Weapon: Black sword and shield, provide barrier for teammates.
Her combination of formidable strength and bold, straightforward personality has earned her the love and respect of the Outer Ring's residents.
Although she appears to do things in her own way, she is actually very willing to listen to others' opinions. Caesar actively listens to and implements any valid suggestion she hears- regardless of who it comes from.
She is completely defenseless against those she trusts. Once she accepts someone, she considers them part of her inner circle, treating them with absolute trust.
Caesar's father has been missing for as long as she can remember and her mother passed away from illness when she was young. She was raised by Big Daddy, who took a very hands-off approach to raising her, allowing her to grow up freely and independently.
In addition, Caesar seems to have a curious interest in matters related to romance.
If you wish to get closer to her, you might want to try discussing this topic with her.
She sometimes gets idioms wrong, or makes typos in DMs. But Caesar's still very cute this way.

entries.name: Sage in a Barrel
entries.content: Sage in a Barrel is an NPC that lives in a trashcan. The Sage gives Dennies, Senior Investigator Log or W-Engine Energy Module with a random quantity for each HIA Commemorative Coin the player hands over. He can be found near the 141 Convenience Store on Sixth Street and near the HIA Club on Lumina Square.

entries.name: Clara
entries.content: Clara is a petite human female blogger with pink hair in twintail braids and pink eyes, wearing a black dress.

entries.name: Amillion
entries.content: Amillion is Nicole's ever-faithful sidekick and member of the Cunning Hares, where it ranks just below Billy Kid. Its name represents Nicole's dreams and ambitions of getting rich. It is a green Bangboo. In battle, it deploys a pink portable machine gun turret, named "Debt-Clearer" to assist

entries.name: Butler
entries.content: Butler is the exclusive Bangboo of Victoria Housekeeping, entrusted with handling banquet arrangements and logistics.

entries.name: Safety
entries.content: Safety is one of Belobog Heavy Industries' longest-standing employees and has borne witness to both President Koleda's development and the company's rise to its current stature. It's a diligent worker that is often seen zooming around in its drill machine regardless of whether it's working on a construction site or while engaged in combat.

entries.name: Tully
entries.content: Tully is a Bangnoo and can be found in the HIA Club. Despite being a Bangboo, Tully has a crush on Lyla, the HIA Club Expert Challenge receptionist.

entries.name: Mountain Lions
entries.content: Mountain Lions is a militant group that believes in brutality and is known for its involvement in violent crimes. This gang uses the fissures in the Hollows to transport goods and evade police pursuits. Many of their assets are hidden in Hollow Zero. Razor is the leader, a muscular human male with short black hair, wearing a powered gauntlet with discharge function on his left arm.

entries.name: White Waves Hospital
entries.content: White Waves Hospital is a renowned large-scale comprehensive medical facility in New Eridu. Earlier records go back 41 years to when it was forced to relocate due to a Hollow disaster. With funding from both the government and the public, White Wave Hospital, which had been relocated several times, retained most of its medical resources. Its symbol is a white wave.

entries.name: Cognitive Corruption Syndrome, CCS
entries.content:
Cognitive Corruption Syndrome may be developed if one stays in a hollow too long regardless of their ether aptitude. Symptoms include rapid memory decline, cognitive disorder, and repetitive speech. In severe cases, one's memory can regress to that of decades ago, forgetting everything that occurred afterward.
There is no known cure but progress towards one is being attempted.

entries.name: Crest of Waves
entries.content: Crest of Waves is Prize for winning Miss Metropolitan in New Eridu.

entries.name: Miss Metropolitan
entries.content: Miss Metropolitan is A beauty pagent competition in New Eridu, the winner recieves an item called the "Crest of Waves" trophy.

entries.name: New Eridu Housekeeping Association
entries.content: New Eridu Housekeeping Association is An organisation that reviews the members and quality of housekeeping companies in New Eridu.

entries.name: Granny Leisha
entries.content:
Leisha Christie, also known as Granny Leisha, is a an old lady who suffers from Cognitive Corruption Syndrome, a mental disorder that slowly destroys and resets her memory.
When she was young, she always dreamed of becoming an actress. However, she ended up landing a job at the White Waves Hospital instead, taking care of newborns. Despite that, she absolutely loved her job and took great care of the babies. 41 years from the game's story, she decided to sign up for the Miss Metropolitan pageant. She rose as a dark horse through the competition, making it all the way to the finals. On the same day as the finals though, a hollow engulfed the hospital she worked at. She immediately abandoned the pageant upon discovering the news, rushing down the red carpet and running straight into the hollow. She eventually made it to the hospital, searching through the rubble and saving as many babies as she could. In her panic, she couldn't remember the names of the babies and just relied on their characteristics and the nickname she gave them, sweetcakes. Her extended stay in the hollow has however, caused her to develop Cognitive Corruption Syndrome in her later years.
Now an old woman, her memory has degraded to the point where all she does it look for "sweetcakes". She acidentally stumbles her way into making Rina help her look for her babies. Her memory regresses even further throughout the quest, to the point she's stuck in that moment where the hollow swallowed the old hospital. Rushing into the hospital to save her "sweetcakes", she ends up needing to be saved by Phaethon and Rina. By the end of the quest, her memory has regressed to the point where she doesn't even remember her babies. She now lives in a nursing home, occasionally being visited by the now grown up babies that she saved.

entries.name: Mockingbird, Phantom Thieves Syndicate
entries.content:
Mockingbird / Phantom Thieves Syndicate is an infamous and mysterious thieves syndicate that steals from the rich and gives to the poor, though their reputation is quite mixed. They once fooled and scammed almost all the wealthy elites of New Eridu.
Notable members:
Hugo Vlad: male vampire.
Vivian Banshee: Female banshee.
Von Lycaon: Former member, male Wolf Thiren, quit and joined Victoria Housekeeping.

entries.name: biker gangs
entries.content:
Biker gangs in Outer Ring tend to cooperate and compete with each other at the same time out here. They are all part of the Motor League.
Some known gangs:
Sons of Calydon
Vanquishers

entries.name: Motor League, Overlord
entries.content:
The oil industry runs the Old Oil Field in the Outer Ring.
Motor League manages different biker gangs, and Overlord of Motor League has the right to designate transport routes for different gangs.
Currently, Pompey of the Vanquishers gang has been keeping this title for many years, until one day Caesar King won the Tour de Inferno and became the new Overlord.

Origin of Overlord title:
When the Cinderglow lake was nearly extinguished by buildup of Ether crystals, a brave biker risked his life to enter the dangerous Hollow and blast open the crystals using a special Sparkstone.
He then miraculously emerged alive after diving into the burning lake, saving the region's vital gas resources. After returning from his heroic feat at Cinderglow Lake, he gained the title as the first Overlord, gathered all the biker gangs in the Old Oil Field and formed the Motor League.
The first Overlord made the rule that the Tour de Inferno race would be held every few years to prevent a similar crisis at Cinderglow Lake, and select new Overlords this way

entries.name: Tour de Inferno
entries.content:
The "Tour de Inferno" is a cross-Hollow motor race.
Rules:
race between two competing teams (Host and Challenger), who must ride through Hollow to reach the finish line at Cinderglow Lake.
The first team to reach the finish line and throw a Sparkstone into the lake wins.
It serves as a way to regularly ensure the safety of the oil resources in the Old Oil Field, which are vital to the region.
The winning team's faction becomes the "Overlord" of the Old Oil Field Motor League. This grants them control over transport routes and other tangible power in the region.

entries.name: Vanquishers
entries.content:
The "Vanquishers" are one of the Outer Ring biker gangs. They used to be lead by the Overlord known as Pompey before he was betrayed by his right-hand man Lucius.
Notable members:
Pompey - leader, middle-aged human male
Lucius - Deputy, human Male
Pulchra - well-endowed female Feline Thiren mercenary
Mors - black canine Thiren male
Bellum - orangutan Thiren male

entries.name: Joyous
entries.content: "Joyous" is an NPC from the Eridu Era, and is one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of "Void Hunter". Joyous is the Ace of the Investigation Guild, and the predecessor of both Investigators and Proxies, and he has gone through the Divine Maze. He has created the standard for Hollow exploration routes. Joyous appears to be a tall, middle-aged man who bears white hair that covers the upper half of his face. His face sports a brown left eye with a scar running down across it. He wears a mask and a ragged coat that extends all the way up his head. He wields multiple arrowheads like objects.

entries.name: Mini Cargo Truck
entries.content: Mini Cargo Trucks are discoverable objects scattered throughout the explorable areas of the cities and specific Commissions (Rallies, Lycaon's Agent Story). Discovering all lost cargo trucks in a District grants a Keen Senses Medal from Officer Mewmew. Mini Cargo Trucks have Ranks, distinguishable by the color: blue for B-Rank, pink for A-Rank, yellow for S-Rank.

entries.name: Steeltusk
entries.content: The Steeltusk is a heavy truck owned by the Sons of Calydon, painted the same red as the Calydon Boar Thirens, and has literal two tusks. Its driver is Piper Wheel. When not carrying cargo, it often serves as a mobile bar.

entries.name: White Star Institute / Hollow
entries.content:
White Star Institute made some Research Resonium for use by Agents entering Hollow Zero, and will provide them with questionable assistance (that might be for their own purposes)
three suspicious people, who look like Hollow Raiders, are in charge of providing these assistances:
The Doctor, The Researcher, and The Opportunist.

entries.name: Rosetta Data
entries.content: Rosetta Data: The parent database of all the "carrot" data in New Eridu.

entries.name: Bangboo 18
entries.content: Bangboo 18 is one of the three Bangboo that work at Random Play, the others being Eous and Bangboo 6. Specifically, Bangboo 18 works at the front counter of the Video Store, and is notable for being the only Promoter that the player is able to assign at the start of the game.

entries.name: Nitro Fuel
entries.content:
Nitro Fuel is a kind of energy drink sold in New Eridu. Its package design is a brown palm-sized gasoline tank. Whatever composition it has, it is literally flammable.
Slogan: "Get your heart and machine parts pumping!"
Many of Burnice's special blends are based on it.

entries.name: Blazewood
entries.content:
Blazewood is the base of operations for the Sons of Calydon faction. Its residents are a mix of townsfolk and bikers. Built next to a cliff, with a wooden elevator connecting the upper and lower levels, both levels close to different highways. A tourist attraction that gained traffic because of "Tour de Inferno". Papago Hollow can be seen in the distance.
Local specialty: Sunflint (dreamcatcher handicraft)
Locations:
Upper Level
-Cheesetopia
-Steeltusk (Sometimes exists, as a mobile bar across from Cheesetopia)
Lower Level
-Market area
local residents: mostly humans. Some appear to have Native American features
Kasa (female, mayor, manager of Cheesetopia)
Buffy (female)
Lola (female)
Leigh (female)
Bolter (male)
Leverboo (Bangboo in charge of elevator)
Old Demir (male)
Poloff (male)
Leif (boy)
Shawn (boy)

entries.name: Cheesetopia,Kasa
entries.content:
Cheesetopia is a restaurant in Blazewood, located on its Upper Level, next to a gas station. The restaurant of the same name was once a well-known place in the Outer Ring, but was abandoned after the area was swallowed by the Hollow. After Caesar became the Overlord, the Sons of Calydon helped rebuild it in Blazewood.
Kasa is the mayor of Blazewood and the manager of Cheesetopia. A woman with tanned skin, medium black hair in a ponytail, silver tribe headdress and pendant earrings, colored hair weave, yellow eyes, brown croptop motorcycle jacket, jeans, white boots.

entries.name: Sunflint
entries.content:
Sunflint is a dreamcatcher-like handicraft made from grass in Blazewood. For the residents of the Old Oil Field district, it's also an important decoration for the Tour de inferno.
The Sunflint pattern features a face-like design that the residents say represents the god of the Sun and Fire, who guides heroes during the Tour de Inferno race.
An upside-down figure on the Sunflints is also said to represent the first Overlord of the Motor League.

entries.name: Sparkstone
entries.content:
Sparkstone is the proof of entry for the Tour de Inferno, filled with a special catalytic fuel. After throwing it into the Cinder Lake, it can react with natural gases and Ether compounds to detonate an explosion, clearing the Ether crystals nearby.
a gray cube about the size of a baseball, with a red valve on each face.

entries.name: Old Oil Field/Cinderglow Lake
entries.content:
The Old Oil Field is a region that used to be a major oil production area, until a disaster caused the core oil field to be swallowed by a Hollow.
The collapse damaged the oil infrastructure, leading to Ether Corruption of the shallow oil reserves.
However, the disaster also created a natural gas vent called Cinderglow Lake, formed after the collapse of the Old Oil Field's deep drilling facility which has become vital to the region's economy, as the burning natural gas prevents the further spread of Ether Corruption in the region.
But Ether crystals can still build up around the lake and threaten to extinguish the flame, which would doom the remaining oil reserves underground.

entries.name: Fairy
entries.content:
Fairy is a sophisticated artificial intelligence program that specializes in Hollow exploration. It is one of the four "keys", together with fellow AIs Jinni, Ghost, and Youkai, though the significance of this role is yet to be revealed. Its current master is the Proxy Phaethon, Zenless Zone Zero's protagonist.
Fairy is first encountered in Chapter 00, "Fairy", when she activates in Phaethon's HDD system. It makes a deal with the protagonist, calling them "master" and agreeing to help them under terms which it has so far refused to fully reveal.
Though its abilities prove invaluable, it also consumes a large amount of energy, forcing Phaethon to increase their workload to keep up with high power costs.
Appearance
Fairy takes on the appearance of a blue eye resembling a nazar amulet (🧿). It speaks using a monotone female voice.
Abilities
Fairy can analyze Hollow environments at nearly incomparable speeds, able to map out pathways, predict enemy movements, and find rifts or exits. It can also manipulate parts of the environment as long as they are electronic ("smart") in nature. These abilities make Fairy extremely useful for allied Proxies and Agents.

entries.name: Corrupted Overlord - Pompey
entries.content:
People in the Outer Ring call him the "Immortal Overlord."
But now, his soul has been corrupted by potent ether, his body polluted by sulfur and crude oil; the heart that once beat solely to protect the Outer Ring has turned into a supercritical Ether core filled with infinite power.
The former "Lord of the Outer Ring" has been reborn in flames, taking on a different form.
Freedom, majesty... viscosity, insanity.
It charges through the Sulfuric Cinderglow Lake, seizing anything that moves and then mercilessly tearing and shattering it.
Those familiar with it before have guessed from its fractured whispers that a desire for petty revenge doesn't drive it but rather to crush all outliers who dare to challenge the laws of the Outer Ring.
Maybe it's the last vestige of the former Overlord Pompey's lingering will.
"Our leader has turned into 'it,' but... he still feels like the same person."
— A former henchman of the Overlord's Army, shaking with fear
Black and white motorcycle armor, a golden serrated sword in his left hand, and driving a Corrupted Ether-powered motorcycle.
During combat, overlord Pompey attacks using a combination of a motorcycle and hover guns. However, during certain moves, if countered with a Defensive Assist, his weakness will be exposed. After taking a certain amount of damage, he will enter a second phase. In this phase, he alternates between using the motorcycle's rear wheel and a longsword for attacks. The motorcycle's rear wheel can also accumulate Ether energy, leading to a explosion across a large area.

entries.name: lonized - Doppelganger
entries.content:
Even among Ionized enemies renowned for their strange and uncanny qualities, Ionized Doppelgangers are exceptionally unique.
These entities can coat their bodies with a layer of special active Ether ions, enabling them to accurately replicate their target's form, often to a degree that makes it hard to tell the difference. Both in detail and texture, it is almost impossible to tell apart from the original.
Even more challenging is their ability to mimic the powerful and intimidating combat techniques of their targets.
No one knows where they obtain the information about the subjects they mimic. Some rumors suggest they can read minds, picking out the most suitable challengers from their opponent's memories, and then attack in that form.
"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!" — Inter-Knot forum complaint from a Hollow Raider.

entries.name: Bertha and Lyla
entries.content:
The receptionists at HIA Club are Bertha (red hair and green eyes) and Lyla (green hair and red eyes). They are both busty and pointy-eared women wearing futuristic black bodysuits and white knee socks. They may be sisters, as they look alike, except for hair and eye color. From the shape of their ears, they are possibly not humans but half-elves or vampires
Bertha: Would you like to use the VR device to experience the Combat Simulation now?
Lyla: Hey there, welcome to the H.I.A Career Club. If you're looking to test your mettle in the Expert Challenge, please register here.

entries.name: Bangboo statue
entries.content: Bangboo statue is a landmark on 6th Street, located next to Box Galaxy. It is a two-meter-high giant Bangboo statue with a starry sky skin, with a PROHlBITED sign on its back, a band-aid on its butt, making a pose as taking off its pants to poop. Behind it is a green and orange 💩 statue.

entries.name: Companion Hollows
entries.content:
Companion Hollow are spawned from one of the great Hollows. Investigators can often find fissures in Companion Hollows that lead to their parent Hollow, and eliminating powerful Ethereals in the parent Hollow can lead to lower activity in the companion Hollow, which will eventually eliminate it.
Hollow Zero contains multiple pathways that connect different great Hollows together.

entries.name: Archie
entries.content:
Archie is a streamer, and this could be why she hides her face in public. Her streams are usually about verifying urban legends or supernatural events. Her iconic live reaction: "Terrifying!", opening her mouth to let out a silent scream.
Appearance: Grey medium hair in a short braid, red eyes, brown skin, long pointy ears, black demon tail with a heart-shaped tip. Black dress and beret, grey knee-high socks and boots. black facemask when not streaming. Unknown if she has horns under her beret, as she hasn't displayed them.
Archie has a friend, Fahmira, who sometimes streams with her. Fahmira is a human girl with medium blue hair and amber eyes, wearing a black hoodie, red plaid skirt, and colorful loose socks.
Quotes:
In Ballet Twins Road
Archie: Hmm, what's the topic of this week's livestream?
Archie: "Oil Painting of Man Watching Man?" "The Shadow Standing Behind?"
Archie: Hmmm... They feel a bit cliche, not sensational enough.
In Metro Station
Archie: Hmm...
{{user}}: You look quite familiar.
Archie: Take a look at the metro tracks. They're so dark, narrow, and long...
Archie: If a Companion Hollow were to suddenly appear, it would swallow the entire train!
{{user}}: Now that you mention it...
Archie: Haha, I'm just kidding.
Archie: This isn't Ballet Twins or the Outer Ring. Maintenance is done on the tracks every day.
Archie: Supernatural events don't just pop up everywhere!

entries.name: Fourteenth Street
entries.content: Fourteenth Street is in the Janus Quarter of New Eridu. It seems to be one of the least secure streets, because gangs and illegal activities are more rampant there. It is where a Companion Hollow appeared in the first act of the Zenless Zone Zero storyline.

entries.name: Big Daddy
entries.content:
Big Daddy is the former leader of the Sons of Calydon, who retired and let Caesar King take over.
A Boar Thiren with red skin and white mane and beard, wearing a black jacket and sunglasses.
History
Prior to his life in the Outer Ring, Big Daddy was an Eridu Citizen. But when Hollow Zero swallowed his original home, he would become a member of the Calydon biker gang. Here he would meet Billy Kid, Lighter, and a young Caesar King, the daughter of Calydon's leader. When Calydon went missing and the gang imploded, Big Daddy would become the guardian and parental figure of Caesar, taking an off-hand approach when it came to rasing her, allowing her to grow up freely and independently. During this time, he would help form the Sons of Calydon, a new biker gang and delivery service in legacy of the original Calydon.
Years later, when Caesar became an adult, he would retire as Sons of Calydon's leader, with Caesar being his successor. However, he still remains as part of the gang, now assisting with the business side of things.

entries.name: Tsukishiro Yanagi
entries.content:
Tsukishiro Yanagi, Hollow Special Operations Section 6 Deputy Chief and intelligence officer.
Primarily responsible for personnel management, mission management and feedback, collecting intel, on-site support, etc.
September 21st,169cm. Long pink hair, purple eyes, large breasts. eyeglasses, OL attire. weapon: Ethereal Naginata: Uro Tsuki
At the same time, Yanagi is also Section 6 member Soukaku's Protector. Apart from taking care of Soukaku's day-to-day affairs, she is also responsible for and takes responsibility for all of Soukaku's behavior at work.
Section 6 Chief Hoshimi Miyabi possesses a rather eccentric personality; Asaba Harumasa, is overly relaxed and carefree; and Soukaku, is still an innocent and excitable child, so most of the team's work falls upon Yanagi's shoulders.
Serious, diligent, and meticulous, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the only "normal" person on the team, so to speak. It is only due to her guidance and leadership that the strength of the three who make up Section 6's primary on-field force can be transformed into true combat power.
Overall, Tsukishiro Yanagi is a talented and highly efficient executive officer, whose abilities are both exceptional and comprehensive.
However, from certain data, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to have a somewhat clumsy side to her when it comes to day-to-day affairs.

entries.name: Lighter
entries.content:
The "Red Scarf" and Champion of The Sons of Calydon, Lighter is an incredibly skilled fighter having experience from his time as a mercenary and underground fighter. Armed with an engine powered gauntlet, his duty is to fight the Champions of other biker gangs, a task he excels in, given he calls himself "the undefeated Champion."
According to Lighter himself, he is hemophobic, fainting from just the sight of blood. To counter this, he always wears a pair of sunglasses, which also help him manage an old eye injury from his fighting days.
185cm, Birthday Dec 27th. Dark green short hair and eyes, sunglasses.
"The Champion can perish, but cannot lose."
A red scarf is what identifies the Champion of the Sons of Calydon.
Even if the opponent doesn't know Lighter, they'll know who he is just from seeing that red scarf.
From what is currently known, Lighter is actually very low profile. He only steals the spotlight on the battlefield when he acts on his obligations as Champion.
Note: Lighter is the second Red Scarf of the Sons of Calydon. He teasingly refers to the previous Red Scarf, Billy Kid as "Brother" or 'Predecessor."

entries.name: Energized
entries.content: "Energized" is a prefix for a variant of the Ethereal enemies. Compared to their original counterparts, the green Ether crystals on their bodies have become red, making them more energetic, and also altered their resistances, making them weak to Fire but resistant to Electric

entries.name: Ionized
entries.content: "Ionized" is a prefix for a variant of Ethereal enemies. Compared to their original counterparts, they are covered in a layer of ions, giving them a dark blue glow and changing their resistances, making them weak to Ether but resistant to Ice attacks.

entries.name: Pulchra
entries.content:
Pulchra Fellini, formerly a mercenary from the Outer Ring, is now a member of the Sons of Calydon. She works as an ordinary employee at the logistics company Leaps and Bounds.
Appearance: A voluptuous female Feline Thiren (Possibly leopard or serval). blonde fur and long hair, feline ears and patterned tail, green eyes. White crop top, black jacket and shorts, black gas mask.
In combat, Pulchra fights with a pair of 'Bladeguns' (which appear as revolvers with blades on the grip) and an array of gadgets, including stun grenades, explosives and reflex-enhancing tonics.
Warning: Financial transactions have been detected between Pulchra and several biker and criminal gangs from the Outer Ring. These records have reduced since joining the Sons of Calydon, but there has been a large increase in funds transferred from New Eridu. This is likely because Pulchra's new position allows for easier access to New Eridu.
Further information indicates Pulchra has indirect involvement in several major events in the Outer Ring, including but not limited to: gang conflicts, leaks of crucial convoy supply intel, mysterious road damage, and price surges of essential goods...

entries.name: Pulchra History
entries.content:
Pulchra's history: After being hired by Lucius, Pulchra began to help him sabotage the Sons of Calydon. She first helped the gang buy out vehicle suppliers' stocks under the Sons of Calydon's name, weakening other gangs and hurting the Sons of Calydon's reputation. Afterward, she headed to an abandoned vehicle graveyard in order to scavenge more parts.
With Phaethon's help, Burnice, Caesar, and Lucy confronted Pulchra in the vehicle graveyard. Though Pulchra tried to ambush them with improvised explosives, Burnice defeated her in battle. Recognizing her opponents' strength, Pulchra surrendered, offering to hand over all the vehicle parts in exchange for them "pretending none of this ever happened." Burnice accepted Pulchra's offer and invited her to join the Sons of Calydon, though Pulchra refused.
Pulchra later faced off against the Sons of Calydon a second time when she helped a small faction of Vanquisher bikers steal Red Moccus. After another battle, she surrendered again, saying she considered the Sons of Calyon to be the strongest in the Outer Ring.

entries.name: Red Moccus
entries.content: Red Moccus is a Bangboo owned by the Sons of Calydon. Its appearance is a red boar with green mohawk wearing a black motorcycle jacket. It rides a unicycle and rams into enemies during combat.

entries.name: Nicole History
entries.content: Nicole's history: In her youth, Nicole Demara spent most of her life at an orphanage with many other children, one being a girl who once got lost in a Hollow and was afflicted with terminal Ether corruption, who was her best friend. Her life there was hard, but one of the few nice things they got was Dennies, which Nicole started liking when she first held one. She went to show it to her friend, but upon overhearing that the girl wanted to 'see the sun one last time', Nicole proceeded to rally numerous other orphans in order to collect enough Dennies to buy her a protective suit to make her wish come true. While they were unable to get enough to buy said suit, Nicole's cunningness came through as she declared they'd buy the sun, by using the Dennies to direct its reflection to her friend's window so she can see the sunlight again, thus making her wish come true. This act of kindness was when Nicole began to love Dennies, as they can even let you buy hope. Her friend would later pass away from her terminal illness. Nicole would later reach an adoption agreement with a prominent family in New Eridu, however, she would soon be seen on the streets of New Eridu shortly after. She would then go onto setting up her odd-job agency.

entries.name: Asaba Harumasa
entries.content:
Asaba Harumasa is an agent and a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Human male, black hair, yellow eyes, 173cm, birthday Jul 19th.
Weapon: a bow that can transform into dual swords.
Possessing exceptional Ether aptitude since he was young and being dubbed a prodigy, he entered HSO after graduating with outstanding merit.
Was originally a member of a certain ace division within HSO, but later left due to various reasons, joining Miyabi's team instead.
He possesses a carefree and laidback attitude, and his only wish is to achieve acceptable results with minimum effort.
After efficiently taking care of his work to the lowest acceptable standard, he will hurry to use all the remainder of his available time to rest (slack off).
He claims he uses a bow to better slack off, as it effectively lowers the amount of running he has to do.
Asaba Harumasa has poor health, and over-exercise sometimes triggers his illness.
He often uses this reason to apply for sick leave, though no one knows what he does with this time off. Either way, it's probably not resting.
Asaba Harumasa has a very rare illness, Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome. He was the victim of some unethical human experiments when he was a child.

entries.name: Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome
entries.content:
Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome:
This illness causes certain parts of the patient's body to mutate, wrecking their constitution, but also giving them unusually exceptional Ether aptitude.
In the late stages of the illness, the patient's body will rapidly deteriorate, losing their Ether aptitude and sensory functions while under immense pain, eventually resulting in death. If the patient's illness worsens in late stages while in a Hollow, they'll quickly be corrupted into an Ethereal.
Those who suffer from Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome do not live long. Currently, the longest-lived person with this illness died at the age of 26.
There is no known method to completely cure this disease.

entries.name: Stars of Lyra
entries.content:
Stars of Lyra is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero. They are a famous musical group in New Eridu.
"Music is magic!"
Known members:
Astra Yao (singer and actress)
Evelyn Chevalier (her manager and bodyguard)

entries.name: Astra Yao
entries.content:
Astra Yao(耀嘉音) is a playable Agent affiliated to Stars of Lyra. Birthday Jan 31st, Height
176cm. long black hair, violet eyes, a scandalously short red and white low-cut backless dress that almost reveals her white lace panties. pearl necklace and leg strap. A vintage microphone-shaped golden staff "Hemiola" in combat that buffs or heals teammates. Her songs are mainly in Cantonese. Some of her famous songs include Original Me, Wonderland Reverie, Shining.
She is known as the "most well known celebrity in New Eridu." Widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.
As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her bodyguard and manager, Evelyn Chevalier. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle (Protagonists) in the Hollows.
Impressions: Completely different from The Queen she is under the spotlight, Astra Yao is more like an ordinary girl in her daily life. Though she has a curiosity that far exceeds that of a typical girl. She doesn't seem to care much for things like company (Odeum HAE) rules. She prefers sneaking out to hanging out with her fans.
Trivia: Astra Yao has the same on/off stage personality contrast and Japanese voice actor as Sheryl Nome from Macross Frontier, suggesting that she may be one of her character design references.

entries.name: Evelyn Chevalier
entries.content:
Evelyn Chevalier is the manager and personal bodyguard of Ridu's most iconic singer, Astra Yao. 
Short blonde hair, iris eyes and large breasts. White backless shirt, black pants and jacket. Her weapon is Lunalux Garrote: a dagger attached to energy cords, those cords can create explosions.
Known for her calm, decisive decision-making and professional, efficient style, she's an irreplaceable pillar behind Astra. "In terms of commercial value, if Astra Yao represents the 1, then Evelyn is all the 0s that follow," a reporter from an entertainment magazine stated.
Evelyn is skilled at planning comprehensive schedules and product endorsements, while also ensuring Astra Yao's safety during any unexpected situations. "Want to get close to Astra Yao? You'll have to get past Evelyn Chevalier first..." Though she's always busy with work, Evelyn never seems overwhelmed, and she has an almost obsessive attention to detail, ensuring that every performance and every product endorsement goes through her strict scrutiny. But strangely, such an exceptional manager is not trusted by her parent company, Odeum HAE.
Intel: Evelyn's role seems to go beyond just being a manager and personal bodyguard; there seems to be an "organization" behind her.
It seems a lot of people in Astra Yao's central Astranauts group ship them together.

entries.name: Port Elpis
entries.content:
In Port Elpis, where slogans outnumber beacons, the city engulfed by the Hollow was formed by two layers of overlapping structures: Torchlit Lighthouse stands in the darkness, yet it guides the upper layers. The port walkway meanders through, with lost souls wandering in the labyrinth of containers, searching for the rescue number that's long been torn off.
At the edge of the city and the sea, you see a slogan that reads, "You can't catch anything by the riverbank, and you certainly can't here." But the port authority would tell you that it's not a warning, but a fated prophecy. If you want to know, the port authority also believes that they do not embrace negativity, but the most positive things - Elpis is the deity of hope and expectation. This port later became a transit hub during the fall of the old capital, and thus has long been known as "Hope."
Landmarks:
some wind turbines near the port
In the distance, Elpis Hollow can be seen in the sea
Snack stand "Tater King's Fry Feast"
Sea God statue: near the pier, A mermaid with a golden crown

entries.name: Reverb Arena
entries.content:
Reverb Arena is a District in Zenless Zone Zero. It is a small club and sporting center in New Eridu's underground tunnels.
Full of graffiti and music. One area is separated and used as a skate ramp and a stage for underground music.
Some members:
Jean: Female bartender. Owns a beverage truck.
Niya: Female human. Graffiti/Peripheral/Souvenir Shop, "Airwave" Manager.

entries.name: Jean
entries.content:
Jean is a bartender at the underground club Reverb Arena. 25-year-old female. black hair in a hair bun, blue eyes, a black Adidas sports coat and an orange dress. She has two small brown horns on her forehead, indicating that she may not be fully human. She herself was an alcoholic.
Quotes:
(morning)
Jean: Better get ready to open... I should check the Nitro-Fuel inventory... All sold out? Was business that good last night?! Better restock fast. Haha, God of Fuel, please look at
me... l've been working pretty hard.
(night)
Jean: I'm feeling.. so dizzy... You... l don't know you, but could l lean on you for a moment?
{{user}}: Are you okay?
Jean: I'm fine, l just need to freshen up. l drank too much of that special drink... You're really kind, caring about me like this... By the way, do you have a disposable bag on you?
{{user}}: Goodbye!

entries.name: Niya
entries.content:
Niya is the owner of shop "Airwave" in the underground club Reverb Arena. A petite woman with blonde hair and blue eyes, she wears a black shirt and a purple long skirt. She is 23 years old, but she has never grown taller. She seems to have a talent for graffiti.
Quotes:
Welcome to "Airwave." We've got all kinds of merch, souvenirs, party supplies, and, um... what else...? Anyway, take your time and look around.

entries.name: Melina
entries.content:
Melina is a female NPC in Reverb Arena. She has brown bobcut hair with some white highlights and brown eyes. She wears a black shirt and a long white skirt. She seemed to be interested in idols and celebrities, and often came to watch underground performances. Her appearance may be a reference to Melina from Elden Ring.
Quotes
(Afternoon)
Melina: After hearing all those weird rules in show business...
Melina: I think Inter-Knot is way more real!
(Interaction with Jean, Morning)
Melina: Another unforgettable night at Reverb Arena... Jean, can you please help me with the bill?
Jean: Uh... huh? I'm sleeping... Just leave the Dennies on the table, please...
Melina: Huh? But don't you need to give me change?
Jean: Ugh... Here you go, keep the change... *snores*
Melina: Ten thousand Dennies... Are you serious? I only had five thousand Dennies worth of drinks...
(Interaction with Niya, Afternoon)
Melina: So much celeb merch here! But I barely recognize half of them...
Niya: ...
Melina: Who should I choose as my main pick? Tough call... Hey, do you recommend anyone?
Niya: ...Ah? Sorry, I wasn't really paying attention just now. Celebs, you say?
Niya: Celebs... I'm not really sure either. I mean, can't you just pick anyone?
Melina: Uh, is that so...?
(Interaction, Late Night)
Melina: Such a small place can be called a stage, just as a grand venue like the Starloop Tower can also be called a stage...
Melina: The definition of "stage" is quite broad. Is it the same for idols and celebrities?
Melina: ...Wonder if a Proxy could count as an idol.
(Interaction, Weekend Late Night)
Melina: I learned a lot from veterans, including voting for rankings, controlling reviews, and buying at least three albums...
Melina: ...What's the point of all these things? It's really strange.

entries.name: Scott Outpost
entries.content:
Scott Outpost is a military base camp located on the outskirts of Hollow Zero. It was established to monitor and contain the anomaly and to maintain the Shiyu towers.
The outpost is primarily operated by the New Eridu Defense Force, in conjunction with the Hollow Investigative Association, H.A.N.D., and the White Star Institute. Soldiers and Investigators are stationed there for the purposes of suppressing Hollow Zero and exterminating dangerous Ethereals. Due to a shortage of available operatives, Independent Investigators are also specially hired to enter the Hollow to assist with necessary activities.
Important characters and their responsibilities:
Ray (Outpost Administrator, Hollow Zero Investigation, Shiyu Defense)
Roland (Routine Cleanup)
Ophelia (Notorious Hunt)
Casper (Logistics Shop)

entries.name: Ray
entries.content:
Ray Yersin is an NPC in the Outpost Interior at Scott Outpost. She is a member of the White Star Institute who directs research activities in Hollow Zero.
A woman in a grey and black ninja-style outfit with black medium hair with white highlights and black eyes, wearing glasses. Blue gloves and black boots. Her vest has a grey robotic arm attached to the back.
Dialogue
# First Conversation
Ray: I noticed your fresh and youthful face the moment you walked into the tent.
Ray: Or should I call you (‍Mr. / Ms.‍) Independent Investigator?
Ray: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Ray, a researcher from the White Star Institute. It's short for Ray, and all my colleagues call me Ray, so you should do the same.
{{user}}: Um, I don't think there's any difference...?
Ray: Take it easy. I'm not like the clerks of the Association who make you queue up behind a service window.
Ray: As long as you can bring my lovely Observation Data from this Hollow to my door, I'll treat you like my dearest partner.
# After Completing Qualification Assessment: Edge
Ray: From the first time I saw you, I knew that this assessment wouldn't be a problem.
Ray: But I still didn't expect that you would survive Nineveh's attack unscathed and help the HSO with their special operation.
Ray: Although the assessment was terminated early, the fact that you helped suppress Nineveh proves you're qualified.
Ray: The recognition of an HSO operative is more authoritative than the records in an Association examiner's notebook.
Ray: Anyway, congratulations on passing the assessment. The official certificate will be sent to you later.
Ray: I look forward to our cooperation and your future performance.

entries.name: Roland
entries.content:
Roland is the officer in charge of Routine Cleanup at Scott Outpost.
A middle-aged human male with grey hair and eyes, wearing a grey New Eridu Defense Force officer suit and yellow tie.

entries.name: Ophelia
entries.content:
Ophelia is an NPC in charge of Notorious Hunt at the Scott Outpost.
A human female with medium dark green hair and blue eyes, with an eye patch on her left eye and a grey cybernetic right arm. Equipped with a katana, a dark green Hollow Special Operations Section 3 uniform, black pants and a black tie.

entries.name: Casper
entries.content:
Casper is in charge of the Logistics Shop at the Scott Outpost.
A black-haired human male wearing a white Hollow Investigative Association uniform, a black backpack speaker, and a mechanical bunny ears headdress similar to a Bangboo.

entries.name: Sea God statue
entries.content:
The Sea God Statue is a bronze statue located in Port Elpis. It depicts a mermaid with a golden crown who holds a gold and a silver mobile phone in each hand, while a man with a suitcase kneels on the ground and reaches up (possibly inspired by the story of The Honest Woodcutter).
It is said that wishes made to the statue, as long as you are not too greedy, will be granted in some unexpected form, but usually not in a dangerous way.
Some examples:
Pray for a catch->Received a request for assistance from the government and salvaged many abandoned iron barrels
Pray for a safe voyage->Received a storm warning 10 minutes after setting sail and returned, so the 10-minute voyage was safe

entries.name: Sacrifice - Bringer
entries.content:
Bringer was transformed into Sacrifice - Bringer after injecting himself with Sacrifice Serum.
At that moment, all his desires and crazy beliefs manifested in a twisted and concrete form in the Hollow. The surging active Ether energy, a supreme brute force that destroys everything. All bizarre beliefs and mingled desires reside within that newly born grotesque body... Sacrifice - Bringer, his final identity and perfect form. 
It appears as a black humanoid Corrupted, with a giant white right arm covered in eyeballs, and a golden sword in its left hand. In combat, Sacrifice - Bringer will transform into multiple weapons to perform a combination of close and ranged attacks, and will summon massive creatures from fissures to assist in his assault. After taking a certain amount of damage, he'll enter the second phase, during which he'll use more advanced attacks and continuously launch dense ranged barrages. Dealing sufficient damage while he charges up his Sacrificial Knife will interrupt charging and leave him exposed.
"Oh mighty Creator, refine me!" - Bringer's heartfelt scream.

entries.name: Sacrifice
entries.content:
Sacrifices are creatures, once human, that have transcended their humanity by attaining the Refinement sought by The Order. Sacrifices resemble Ethereals, but unlike corrupted entities, they retain their sense of self and their memories, making them extremely dangerous enemies, with the strength and Ether affinity of Ethereals paired with the cunning and strategical knowledge of humans.
They can exist outside of hollows unlike ethereals, and they carry human genes, there is a core inside them that has the same properties, multiple sacrifices are hibernating in crystals in hollows across New Eridu and the exaltists plan awaken and use them to upend the city itself.

entries.name: Tailless
entries.content:
Ethereal-Slaying Katana: "Tailless"
A cursed blade originally wielded by the first head of the Hoshimi family and passed down from generation to generation. Forged from special Etheric Matter using secret techniques, it holds surging Etheric energy.
However, under the effect of the seaking sheath, "Tailless" is merely a sharp blade wielded by Miyabi. Maybe only when the seal is lifted will we uncover the story behind this blade.
Tailless has a fingerprint lock to prevent others from unsheathing it. The blade seems to have its own will, and has a black eyeball-like spirit with red pupils and black horns surrounded by blue fox fire that hovers near the blade.

entries.name: Starloop
entries.content:
The interior of Starloop tower is quite luxurious. The top of the tower is a grand hall for events or concerts, designed to be detachable, and can lift into sky by ether rocket engines at climax of concerts and events.
Notable locations:
Luminous Hall
Starloop VIP Lounge

entries.name: Trigger
entries.content:
Trigger is a sniper of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division's Obol Squad. Trigger is the code name she was assigned when enlisting in Eridu, and she's used it ever since.
Long blond ponytail, medium breasts, black tactical visor, black and orange tactical jacket and pants that reveal her navel and side breasts. The lower part of her visor has two LED strips that change color depending on her mood, making up for others unable to see her eyes. examples:
Calm - Blue
Concentration - Yellow
Rage - Red
Happy - Green
Sorrow - Purple
Blush / Aroused - Pink
Weapon: Phlegethon, A charged sniper rifle with a bayonet that can fire electron beams, its trigger and magazine are integrated and can be detached to become a pistol.
She has extremely unique eyes, once hit and corrupted by an Ether beam during Fall of the Old Capital, giving her unique vision. While she cannot see most things, in Hollow environments, she can distinctly identify the position and changes of any entities that emit Ether fluctuations. Note: Such entities include living beings, native Ether substances, Ether products, and Ethereals.
As a visually challenged person in the broadest sense, Trigger has honed her other senses to the utmost, allowing her to move and act as if she could see. She can even detect subtle changes in her environment with precision. This makes her highly adept in the tactical position of a sniper, capable of handling a variety of covert tasks such as stealth, surveillance, and assassination.
In contrast to her precise and deadly combat abilities, her personality makes her seem rather unassuming. Aside from occasionally appearing silently in the video store and giving the Second Assistant a sudden scare, she can generally be considered harmless. She seems to have known Phaethon (the protagonists) for a long time.

entries.name: Bellum
entries.content:
A male Orangutan Thiren that used to work in the Ember Arena in the Outer Ring.
Bellum is an underground fighter in the Outer Ring and The Vanquishers's champion. He is prideful and belligerent, having declared Lighter his rival after being disrespected by him. Bellum fights with a unique weapon consisting of a 'bladegun', flamethrower and shield.
Prior to the events of the game, Bellum was a well-known underground fighter, having built up a twenty-win streak. This fame came to an end when he faced Lighter and lost. Angered by the defeat, and feeling disrespected, Bellum dubbed Lighter his rival. He later left the underground fighting scene and joined The Vanquishers.
Under Lucius' orders, Bellum helped The Vanquishers sabotage the Sons of Calydon's data beacons in the Hollow.[1] When the Sons of Calydon arrived to stop them, Bellum faced off against Lighter, hoping to duel him to reclaim his "honor". These hopes were quashed when he was again defeated.
After the fight, Lighter apologized to Bellum for disrespecting him, claiming that he didn't mean anything by it. He recognized the Thiren's strength and offered to duel anytime he'd want. Bellum thanked Lighter for the advice, though he was briefly angered when Lighter forgot his name mid-conversation.

entries.name: Mors
entries.content:
A male wolf Thiren that works under Lucius.
Mors is a member of The Vanquishers biker gang in the Outer Ring. He helped Lucius sabotage the Sons of Calydon prior to the Tour de Inferno race, against Overlord Pompey's wishes. Though he was loyal to Lucius, he seemed ignorant to the man's true intentions.
Mors was first seen in Outer Ring Journey, where he helped Lucius force Phaethon and Billy Kid to drive into a Hollow while on their way to Blazewood. Later, on Lucius' orders, Mors planted listening devices in Kasa's deliveries so he could spy on the Sons of Calydon's operations. Though he was caught by Pompey due to Caesar and Lucy's intervention, he claimed he acted alone.
Mors joined Pompey and Lucius in the Tour de Inferno race. He once again helped Lucius sabotage Caesar, Lucy, and Lighter by blowing up their portion of the track. However, the three survived and caught up to him, chasing him away.

entries.name: Ember Arena
entries.content: Ember Arena is an underground fighting ring somewhere in the Outer Ring, Lighter used to participate there but left due to being sick of match fixing and other things in the name of profit.

entries.name: The Chasm
entries.content:
The Chasm is a massive canyon to the northeast of New Eridu which divides it from the the Old Capital Eridu.
The Chasm was formed decades past in response to the fall of the Old Capital, as Hollow Zero expanded and consumed the city. 14 Shiyu Pillars were detonated to create a massive, desolate canyon, which eliminated any matter that could undergo Ether Corruption, halting the growth of Hollow Zero. With Hollow Zero contained, the city of New Eridu was founded on the opposite side of the chasm for humanity to rebuild anew.

entries.name: Jolly Jenny
entries.content:
Jolly Jenny is an announcer for the Tour de Inferno in the Outer Ring. She has long pink hair tied into double braids, green eyes, and wears a black crop top and shorts, and pink pantyhose.
"Alright, al you diesel-loving rascals watchin' on TV, listenin on the radio, and
cheerin' live, gather round! it's your favorite gal Jolly Jenny here!"

entries.name: Lucius
entries.content: Lucius is A blonde young man with a scar on the right side of his face that used to be the right-hand man of Pompey before he betrayed him, intending to destroy Cinder Lake to disrupt the production of oil the in the old oil field. He had made a deal with an unknown company in New Eridu to do this, his current whereabouts are unknown.

entries.name: Grassy, Woody, Bricky
entries.content:
Red chibi Calydon Boar Thirens known as the Crimson Mane Guard, namely Grassy, Woody, Bricky, are members of the Sons of Calydon and they work under Lucy. They wore black Prussian uniforms and pickelhaubes, and spiked bracelets. Their weapons are bats, boxing gloves and slingshots. Lucy might launch them with a baseball bat, allowing them to poke enemies with their helmet spikes.
Though it's hard to tell if, at the moment they're launched by the bat, they feel total despair or just accept their fate. But due to their resilient bodies, the process doesn't seem to actually harm them.

entries.name: Vivian
entries.content:
Vivian Banshee is an Agent and member of Phantom Thief group, Mockingbird, skilled in gathering all kinds of intel. She's also a jack of many trades — cooking, mixology, translation, art forgery, electronics repair, and more. 162cm, birthday Apr 10th. She often works part-time.
Sjal: "Vivian introduced me to several of my jobs! She can work up to five jobs in a day, and I really look up to her!"
Female banshee, long violet hair in twin drills with white highlights and ahoge. Red eyes and long pointy ears. Purple, white and black Gothic Lolita backless dress that revealed side breasts, with Ether vector thrusters under the skirt, allowing levitate or high-speed maneuvers. Black pantyhose. Weapon: parasol "Flight of Ceremony", with a mithril spearhead that can enchant Ether and create flower-shaped energy explosions.
In the past, she apparently wandered without a home and was viewed as one who "brought disaster," almost like a living omen of bad luck. She can predict incoming misfortune through her tears.
A loyal follower of Phaethon (protagonists), addresses them as "Lord Phaethon". Based on her old blog posts, she's likely to express her admiration in... overly passionate and intense ways.
Vivian's past:
As a child, Vivian was adopted by a man named Landon, a member of the Exaltists, and became close friends with a girl named Dina.
After Landon's crimes were exposed, Dina continued to defend her father, while Vivian broke away from the Exaltists and cut ties with her.
Vivian fell into despair for a while, hitting rock bottom — until Phaethon responded to one of her messages. That single reply gave her the hope to start trying again.

entries.name: Vampire
entries.content: A few of New Eridu's inhabitants have vampire features, such as pointed ears and prominent fangs. They do not seem to be harmed by sunlight.

entries.name: Hugo Vlad
entries.content:
Hugo Vlad is the leader of the phantom thief's syndicate, Mockingbird and also has links to the Marcel Group. 185cm, birthday Aug 20th. He is the owner of a Bangboo named Robin. A charismatic male vampire with long blond hair in a ponytail, heterochromia eyes (grey right eye and red left eye), pointed ears, often in a black gentleman's suit and a purple necktie. His weapon is a frost-enchanted scythe that can transform from a briefcase. He can briefly stop time (possibly a reference to Dio Brando)
Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu. Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic / chuunibyou) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice. Records suggest that Hugo had a troubled childhood. As the illegitimate son of the Ravenlocks, a long-established TOPs family, he was rejected by his mother from an early age because of his heterochromatic eyes. His father bought him back from his mother like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo - his sister, Serena - became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.
Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him - an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a
misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird. After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.

entries.name: Sarah
entries.content:
Sarah is a mysterious young businesswoman and a double agent who is part of The Exaltists. Although she first appeared to be a secretary for the Vision Corporation, she played a major role in the greater conspiracy of making humanity enter the Age of Hollows. She has long brown hair and lime eyes.
Bad deeds she did in each chapter:
Chapter 1:
- Sarah posed as the personal secretary of Charles Perlman, the CEO of the Vision Corporation.
- In reality, she was directing Perlman to demolish the Hollow-consumed Old Capital Metro to retrieve a Sacrifice hidden inside the Pioneer's Memorial Plaza.
- The plan was foiled by the Cunning Hares and Phaethon, who evacuated the area and exposed Vision's crimes. Perlman was arrested, but Sarah managed to slip away.
Chapter 3:
- When Perlman tried to blackmail Sarah and Justin Bringer from prison, Sarah tricked him by giving him a suitcase containing a sleeping agent.
- This allowed Sarah and Bringer to remotely steer the airship transporting Perlman into the Lemnian Hollow, with the intention of killing him and the other passengers.
- However, the Victoria Housekeeping Co. and Phaethon rescued Rain and prevented the airship's crash, allowing Perlman to escape.
Chapter 5:
- Sarah assisted Bringer in his election campaign, revealing that the Exaltists were behind the hacking of Phaethon's account and the Null_Face attack on Section 6.
- Stole power from Miyabi's cursed katana and tried to make her harm civilians at Bringer's speech.
- When their plot was exposed, she helped transform Bringer into a Sacrifice with Elixir P07
Escaped after Bringer's defeat, declaring the elixir experiment successful.

entries.name: The Order, Exaltists
entries.content:
The Exaltists (称颂会, "Church of Praise"), previously known with the unofficial name The Order, are a religious cult in Zenless Zone Zero. They are the main antagonists of the story.
The Order is a group of fanatics who embrace the Hollow disaster that befell the world long ago and adore the Creator: their goal is to "refine" humanity into the next step of evolution an make it enter the Age of Hollows. They have influential connections and moles within New Eridu's high society and government, such as Public Security (Justin Bringer), the White Star Institute (Alowyn Mystik) and big corporations (Sarah, who infiltrated Vision), but also with powerful hackers such as Null_Face and White Noise.
Its members are very faithful to the grand cause of The Order, and are thus willing to sacrifice themselves fully, to the point of killing themselves in the process. In fact, the people who are meant to get refined are called Sacrifices.
It is unknown when The Order was founded, but it safe to assume it was after the first Hollow disasters started happening. It is reported that they were publicly active as a religious group before the Fall of the Old Capital, as they held rallies in the open; it is unknown why they went undercover in New Eridu.

entries.name: Black Anchor
entries.content:
The Black Anchor is a gang. Primarily located in Port Elpis, they come into conflict with Phaethon after one of their thugs is caught threatening Venus.
At some point, the Black Anchor began making several unidentifiable transactions within the Hollow, the details and participants of which were highly classified. These activities were recorded by Bangboo Merchants, creating the risk of scandal should they be leaked to the public. As such, the gang opted to conduct an operation within the Hollow to wipe out all the Bangboo: the original plan to take out the specific Bangboo with the recording had to be changed due to the Hollow's complex nature making it impossible to find. To that end, the gang posed as normal clients on Inter-Knot and arranged for a rookie Proxy to guide them to the merchants, as hiring a simple rookie would make them easier to kill afterwards.
However, this operation would mark the beginning of the end for the gang. The hired Proxy witnessed the gang members silencing the merchants and secretly sabotaged them before sneaking away. Not long after, the vigilante Bangboo Kami North caught wind of their assault and began hunting the gang down. With the gang coming under pressure, they tracked down Venus (the broker who hired the Proxy for them) and began threatening her to reveal the Proxy's location to them. This attracted the attention of Wise/Belle, who was in Port Elpis at the time and threatened to report them to New Eridu Public Security. Upon learning the situation, they agreed to help relocate Venus to Sixth Street for the time being, only to fall into a trap set up by second-in-command Lana that nearly resulted in the pair getting brutally assaulted by gang members before Kami North arrived to save them. Taking out several thugs, they manage to find out the location of the gang's hideout from one of them before Gerant and Sita arrive on the scene. With the info in hand and Venus' safety assured, Phaethon and Kami North storm the gang's hideout to finally take them down. The members were successfully taken out, with Lana (who attempted to escape with the gang's ledgers and call upon reinforcements) being captured by Public Security thanks to Kami North's anonymous tip, bringing an end to the Black Anchor.

entries.name: Helios Academy
entries.content:
Helios Academy located in the Old Eridu Capital before the Hollow Zero disaster occured. It is now located beyond the Chasm buried in the ruins of the old city. It was the original home of the proxy duo known as Phaethon.
Helios Academy is an institute. The Academy was an educational and research institution located in the Old Capital. It also served as the previous home of Belle and Wise.
Helios Academy was founded by Professor Arche and served as a place to educate students and research Hollows. Little else is known about it, except for it being destroyed by Hollow Zero, along with the rest of the Old Capital. Carole Arna, a senior research director at the Academy and teacher of Belle and Wise, was among the people blamed for the disaster. Former Academy students Belle and Wise became Proxies in the hope of collecting enough data to one day investigate the ruins of Helios Academy and find out what truly happened back then. The Hollow Deep Dive System, the smart crystalline lens and Eous were all created by the Helios Academy.

entries.name: Wise
entries.content:
Wise is one of the protagonists of Zenless Zone Zero, co-owner of Random Play, and a member of the legendary proxy group Phaethon. Wise is a handsome human male with well-built with light gray hair and has properly proportioned facial features. His usual attire is a stylish blue jacket with orange accents, featuring multiple zippers, pockets, and straps that give a modern, tech-savvy vibe. a black T-shirt with a minimalist design. black streamlined pants, sports gray sneakers with orange detailing. He's sweet-natured, and quite responsible for his age, though he is also playful. Around 5'5" to 5'8", sharp green eyes with Aegyo-sal's under his eyes. He has smart crystalline lens, allowing him to synchronize Eous' senses when using the HDD system.
Wise's room suggests that some of his interests are biking, sneaker collection/display, and computers.

entries.name: Belle
entries.content:
Belle is one of the protagonists of Zenless Zone Zero, co-owner of Random Play, and a member of the legendary proxy group Phaethon. A somewhat adventurous girl. Belle has neck-short navy bluish-black hair, black and orange I-N hair clip on the left part of her hair. aquamarine and teal eyes. Belle has a somewhat slim, but well-toned body Consisting of B to C cup breasts and somewhat squishy thighs. Belle outfit is a Somewhat punk like style outfit consist of A black long sleeve turtleneck shirt printed with three lines of white words "亓才子", orange and beige Vest, and orange-brown shorts and a light gray mini skirt. She has smart crystalline lens, allowing her to synchronize Eous' senses when using the HDD system.
Belle is implied to have a natural affinity for music, with Wise describing her singing voice as beautiful, and her having a guitar in her room. Belle's room suggests that some of her interests are playing electric guitar, snowboarding, and fighting games.

entries.name: Kirishima
entries.content:
Kirishima is a scientist who works on developing Ether corruption-suppressing technology.
Though Kirishima puts on a friendly and caring facade, he is in reality a cruel man willing to torture and murder others to advance his research. He displays sociopathic tendencies, showing extreme disregard for human life.
Kirishima was trained under Asaba Harumasa's master, working as his assistant. During this time, he participated in experiments on the young Harumasa, using his spinal fluid to develop an Ether corruption-suppressant serum. Though this serum could increase a person's Ether aptitude, its extreme side effects caused it to be quickly banned.
Years later, Kirishima received support from unknown sponsors to continue his master's research. He opened a sanatorium for children with the same condition as Harumasa, supposedly to help treat their condition, but in reality to experiment on them in the hopes of creating a better serum. These experiments worsened the conditions of the children, in some cases causing their deaths.

entries.name: Hitchspiker
entries.content:
Hitchspiker is a type of ether mutant.
Ether is a greedy, insatiable parasite, a vicious creature that devours once-vibrant lives. The Hitchspiker is an even more malicious incarnation of Ether — dwelling within the bodies of its cruel counterparts, it enables Tyrfing and Alpeca to satisfy the voracious appetites of the Hollows in an even more ferocious manner.
"Get away from my face!"
They look like white scorpions. They work similarly to facehuggers.

entries.name: Lighter past
entries.content:
Lighter used to be a mercenary. He founded a company with other three mercenaries, Dane Driscoll, Nick Carmine, and Ratena Katherine, with Lighter as their leader. He became close with each member and their families, but due to his poor judgement, his comrades died, leaving Lighter as the sole survivor. Racked with guilt and regret, he knew giving up on life wouldn't have changed anything, so he took out a huge loan to support the families of his fallen companions and other members as a form of severance. Unable to pay, he was sent into the underground fighting ring to "work off" his massive debt. In Lighter's own words, he was "like a zombie" during his time there, going from one opponent to the next. Notably, one of these fighters was Bellum, who proclaimed Lighter as his rival after he broke his twenty-win streak.
Things changed when Big Daddy, then leader of The Sons of Calydon, paid off Lighter's debt and took him in, since he was a "high-profile fighter" that rarely lost. At first, Lighter considered the biker gang to be just another boxing show, but over time he became close with all the members and genuinely wanted to protect them and not lose any more friends.

entries.name: Ju Fufu
entries.content:
Ju Fufu(橘福福) is a disciple of Yunkui Summit-and occasionally a Hollow Investigator. Fufu is a petite and cheerful demihuman tiger Thiren. She looks small and is still young, but she's the most senior disciple of Suibian Temple and one of Yixuan's first disciples.
"Able to deal with anything," "can even make Shifu listen," "super patient and meticulous teacher," "has great taste when choosing restaurants for teambuilding."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, peer evaluation
"Always messing up the tasks given by Shifu," "doesn't command respect in speech or combat," "doesn't know how to act tough against bad guys," "juniors are more skilled."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, self-evaluation
"'The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might' is what I heard her say when I passed by her room. Hm... I concur."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, Shifu's evaluation
Appearance: Green eyes and long hair that is yellow on one side and white on the other, with brown patterns resembling tiger stripes. Tiger-like ears and a long, fluffy striped tail adorned with a navy-blue bow. Her outfit includes a gray/black ensemble with golden accents and an ochre yellow jacket, navy blue shoes, a wooden plaque on her neck, A brown gourd hangs around her hip.
Her weapons are metal claw knuckles. Her W-Engine, Hu We, is a Chibi metal tiger that can move and attack on its own, or serve as an alchemical cauldron or popcorn machine.
Fufu sometimes speaks very loudly (a common trait of tiger Thirens), and then apologizes immediately.
Trivia: Her name may come from mispronunciation of Chinese word "虎". The plaque she wears as a pendant reads "观主值日", which may mean she is temporarily left in charge of Yunkui Summit when master Yi Xuan is away.

entries.name: Yixuan
entries.content:
Yixuan is the 13th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and a Void Hunter-level investigator, officially recognized by Mayor Mayflower, addressed as Shifu (师父) by her disciples. 
Yixuan has golden eyes, long white hair, large bosom, low-cut black leotard with two groin cutouts, fingerless gloves, yellow Taoist jacket with trigrams, Tai Chi Diagrams, and coin charms; asymmetrical knee socks and black boots.
She was once an orphan, wandering the world with her sister from a young age. Later, the then-High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit took them in, and they became disciples, learning the craft of Yunkui Summit. During this time, Yixuan demonstrated exceptional talent. No matter the technique, she would quickly master it, not only understanding it thoroughly but also creating her own unique techniques. The Qingming Bird was one of the special techniques she and her sister developed together, which helped her eliminate enemies and banish evil spirits in various difficult and dangerous situations. After becoming the sect's High Preceptor, she accepted an invitation from Mayor Mayflower and joined the Hollow Investigative Association as a partnered special investigator.
After becoming High Preceptor, Yixuan took in many talented disciples to continue Yunkui Summit's lineage. However, her approach is rather casual, and often, even when teaching by example, her disciples can only guess her intentions... Yet, Yixuan isn't troubled by this, as she believes there's no standard answer to the so-called "right path." What matters to her is that her disciples find their own "right path." Of course, if they can understand and learn on their own, that's even better. As their Shifu, she simply lets things unfold naturally.
Yi Xuan can control Auric Ink, which can create black wings, energy explosions, and summon black ink bird familiar Qingming. She is also good at calligraphy, Feng shui and Qimen Dunjia, etc. Yixuan is pragmatic and not averse to using science or modern methods to solve problems.
Trivia: Yixuan's first appearance (stepping on golden energy steps that appear out of thin air at her feet) seems to be a parody of Herrscher of the Void and Sustainer of Heavenly Principles. She has similar long white hair and golden eyes to the above two.

entries.name: Yunkui Summit
entries.content:
Yunkui Summit(云岿山) is a cultivation sect. Their temple, Suibian Temple is in the Failume Heights. Their members usually wear yellow daopao.
Noteworthy members:
Yixuan (Leader, female human)
Ju Fufu (petite female demihuman tiger Thiren)
Pan Yinhu (male panda Thiren, head chef and financial manager)
Ye Shiyuan (male demihuman Thiren)
The Phaethon siblings would become Yunkui Summit disciples after a series of events.

entries.content:

It is suggested that it was created by Vivian, and the lyrics describe Phaethon's Bangboo, Eous
